mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 4.0% for two consecutive months, it signals a tight labor market that boosts corporate profit margins through wage growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE has been below 4.0% for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in residential construction permits (HOUST) and real consumer spending (RSAFS) signals strong household demand, which accelerates corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of accelerating industrial production growth (INDPRO > 1.5% YoY for 3 months), manufacturing capacity utilization rises, boosting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO growth exceeds 1.5% YoY for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) over the past 6 months, as measured by the current level relative to a 6-month moving average, signals robust labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where PAYEMS has shown a rising trend over 6 months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When residential construction permits (HOUST) exceed 1300.0 thousand units for two consecutive months, it signals strong housing market activity that boosts consumer confidence and corporate capital expenditure, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where HOUST has exceeded 1300.0 for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and an increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.0% YoY signals a monetary policy response to inflation, which supports real equity valuations and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining FEDFUNDS and rising CPIAUCSL fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In the late-cycle expansion phase, characterized by low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.5%) and strong payroll growth (PAYEMS > 100k YoY), corporate profit margins expand due to labor cost discipline, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods matching the late-cycle expansion regime (UNRATE < 4.5% and PAYEMS growth > 100k YoY), or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
